limitations: Qualification applies to the listed profile, estimator, targets and budgets; it does not cover every optional setting.
No global finite-sample unbiasedness or universal posterior accuracy claim is made.
The migration bias check uses100 same-seed native/shared pairs per case, not1000 paired runs; the1000 cohorts are independent precision studies.
Paper efficiency points are treated as fixed; their Monte Carlo uncertainty and rounding are not included. Confidence intervals do not waive the1.10 point gate.
Existing100-run cases are listed as100, never relabelled1000. Prior100 and1000 cohorts are not pooled.

The closed-support/identical-seed scale fallback is an explicitly declared numerical variant, not a boundary rule claimed to have been specified by the source paper. The old author_latest default remains available and is not the qualified entrypoint.
gate: Elog/source_Elog <=1.10, no CI waiver and no runtime errors
Elog: mean(Ncal)*(sample_SD(log Z)/abs(printed source log Zref))^2; ddof=1
bias_scope: No new migration-induced difference in100 exact paired histories per case; global unbiasedness is not certified.

public_regression_compatibility.description: Public regression compatibility: generic arbitrary-chain coverage explicitly selects GroupMode=available (36 calls for12 chains and3 steps). A separate author_latest fixed-group test preserves the source five-group behavior (39 calls for the same shape), including its repeated last-chain visit. No model, engine, kernel or profile default changed.
public_regression_compatibility.limitations: The preserved public suite ran21 small synthetic/contract tests:19 ordinary passes,1 documented expected failure for an inherited all-negative-prefix signed-log limitation, and1 explicit skip of a legacy MATLAB trajectory replay not qualifying the closed-support variant. Fixture-corruption checks remain active. This is a repository compatibility check, not another benchmark or evidence-unbiasedness certificate.
